verbs.name: connect
verbs.blurb: onboards a project and asks where it lives
verbs.description: Link a project to its vault. Infers slug, type, and status, confirms one card of required fields, applies with a receipt. Idempotent.

verbs.name: status
verbs.blurb: reports where you are, what is wrong, and what is stale
verbs.description: Make derived state current (brief date, handoff, index row), then report in three bands: what is wrong now, what is going stale, and what is worth a look.

verbs.name: clean
verbs.blurb: removes what the vault does not need
verbs.description: Cleanup sweep: indexes, wikilink form, updated dates, off-schema frontmatter. Previews then applies, and never creates a vault file. --deep adds the structural pass. [vault|repo|all] adds repo symlinks.

verbs.name: dream
verbs.blurb: reads the prose and reports what only judgement finds
verbs.description: Semantic refresh, the deepest tier: surfaces stale, superseded, redundant, or orphaned content as scored candidates you judge before anything changes. --folder scopes the walk to one subtree.

verbs.name: board
verbs.description: Scaffold a self-hosted kanban seeded from tasks/: drag to move, saved to disk. Re-seeding keeps your dragged cards. Use --project SLUG or --all.
